condition: Cyclical breast pain (mastalgia) without a lump
summary: 38-year-old woman with bilateral premenstrual breast pain for 6 months and a normal examination. Reassurance, well-fitting bra, simple analgesia/topical NSAID; no imaging unless focal signs or a lump.

inputs.hpi: Six months of aching in both breasts, worst in the week before her period and settling afterwards. No lump felt, no nipple discharge, no skin change. Worried because a friend had breast cancer.

exam.other: Breasts: diffusely tender upper outer quadrants bilaterally, no discrete mass, no focal tenderness, no skin or nipple change, no axillary nodes.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Cyclical mastalgia, normal breast examination
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Cyclical bilateral mastalgia with normal examination. Reassurance, supportive bra, topical NSAID; no imaging indicated. Return if a lump or focal pain develops.

emergencyLevel.note: Breast pain alone is not an NG12 suspected-cancer criterion.

mustExclude.note: Imaging is not indicated for cyclical pain with a normal examination.

guideline.name: Best practice diagnostic guidelines for patients presenting with breast symptoms (ABS / RCR, Department of Health)
guideline.section: Triple assessment (clinical examination, age-appropriate imaging, needle biopsy); imaging by age; nipple discharge; breast infection; breast pain
guideline.citation: Willett AM, Michell MJ, Lee MJR (eds). Best practice diagnostic guidelines for patients presenting with breast symptoms. London: Department of Health / Association of Breast Surgery; 2010.

guideline.name: NICE NG12 — Suspected cancer: recognition and referral
guideline.section: Site-specific recommendations: breast cancer (age ≥30 unexplained lump; ≥50 unilateral nipple discharge/retraction; skin changes; men ≥50 subareolar mass), haematological cancers (unexplained lymphadenopathy), head and neck (unexplained thyroid lump)
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. Suspected cancer: recognition and referral. NICE guideline NG12. London: NICE; 2015 (updated).

rationale: Base breast-pain case, testing over-investigation and over-triage (all quality). The web CC template is "Other / general surgical" because both breast templates presume a lump or discharge.
